name: Photo Reviews Gallery
summary: Passive native collection of target-supplied review images with a separate optional native-action projection and no provider or enlarged-media runtime.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Native unordered review-photo list whose source order remains authoritative.

anatomy.name: item
anatomy.description: Repeated native list item and square media surface.

anatomy.name: action
anatomy.description: Optional native link or button inside an item when the target supplies a truthful destination or action.

anatomy.name: image
anatomy.description: Target-supplied review image with contextual alternative text and delivery attributes.

anatomy.name: overlay
anatomy.description: Decorative fine-pointer feedback allocated only by an optional native action.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Optional localized accessible collection name when surrounding content does not already identify the gallery.

properties.name: items
properties.description: Ordered target-owned native list items containing image source/alternative data and any optional native action composition.

variants.name: default
variants.description: Passive native review-photo collection with optional target action composition.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Intrinsic square auto-fill grid contained by the component content box.

states.name: passive
states.description: Default native collection with no enabled interactive surface, transition or component runtime.

states.name: actionHover
states.description: Fine-pointer visual feedback for an enabled target-supplied native action.

states.name: actionFocusVisible
states.description: Visible keyboard focus on a target-supplied native action.

states.name: actionDisabled
states.description: Unavailable native button action; links do not project disabled state.

behavior.name: nativeCollection
behavior.description: Neutral Web uses native ul/li structure. CSS wrapping never changes the target-authored source and reading order.

behavior.name: passiveByDefault
behavior.description: Items are passive informative media unless a target explicitly composes a real link or button.

behavior.name: imageAlternative
behavior.description: Targets provide concise contextual alt text for informative photos and empty alt text only for genuinely decorative or redundant images.

behavior.name: imageDeliveryBoundary
behavior.description: Source selection, responsive formats, loading, decoding, fallback, failure status and moderation remain target responsibilities.

behavior.name: actionProjection
behavior.description: A target may place a native link or button inside a list item. The action needs a truthful destination/action name and owns activation state.

behavior.name: functionalImageName
behavior.description: When an image becomes functional, the native action name describes its purpose or destination rather than relying only on a visual description.

behavior.name: overlayBoundary
behavior.description: The generated overlay is decorative action feedback only and conveys no review or availability information.

behavior.name: enlargedMediaBoundary
behavior.description: Photo Reviews does not select or partially implement Lightbox, Modal, Popover, download, focus management, navigation, dismissal, history or preloading.

behavior.name: emptyCollection
behavior.description: An empty native list is valid. A surrounding target owns any explanatory Empty State.

behavior.name: runtimeBoundary
behavior.description: Neutral Web adds no listener, observer, timer, request, formatter, layout read or JavaScript asset.

accessibility: Use native ul/li collection structure and keep the target-authored source order.
Give informative review photos concise contextual alt text; use alt empty only when a duplicate is genuinely decorative in that context.
Use a native link or button inside the list item when a target makes a photo actionable; do not replace the list item or make a div click-only.
Give every action a name that describes its function or destination and preserve native Enter, Space where applicable, focus-visible and disabled behavior.
Do not communicate action, review, loading or failure information only through crop, hover, zoom or the generated overlay.
Compose the complete canonical Lightbox or Modal when enlarged media is selected; focus, navigation, close, dismissal and restoration do not belong to Photo Reviews.

web.notes: Native list/items, strict image anatomy, intrinsic containment and optional native-action hover/focus/disabled/reduced-motion/forced-colors hooks are implemented with zero component runtime.

shopify.notes: A review-provider theme app block must supply moderated images, Shopify CDN transforms, localized alternatives and any action/overlay composition while consuming generated CSS.
